title: hahnia aria
intro: Hahnia aria, commonly known as the Indian snakeroot or Chakrandi, is a plant species in the family Apocynaceae. It is a shrub native to the Indian subcontinent, used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The plant is known to have anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as reducing fever, soothing digestive issues, and treating skin conditions. Hahnia aria's bioactive constituents include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
